fact: Smart Zambia Institute issued on 3 December 2025 a World Bank-financed request for proposals (about USD 19 million) for a system integrator to deploy and integrate the foundational digital ID and CRVS core modules, including data migration, with proposals due 22 January 2026.
title: System Integrator Sought for Zambia's Digital ID and Civil Registration Infrastructure
publisher: IndexBox Tenders (reproducing World Bank notice WB-OP00412626, Smart Zambia Institute)
